vignette: A 78-year-old woman on warfarin has become confused and unsteady over three weeks and now has a mild left hemiparesis. CT shows a crescent-shaped collection over the right hemisphere that is slightly darker than brain and crosses the coronal suture.
explanation: A crescentic, hypodense extra-axial collection that crosses sutures in an elderly anticoagulated patient with a subacute course is a chronic subdural hematoma from torn bridging veins; an epidural hematoma is biconvex, hyperdense and does not cross sutures.
